Gambling | Difficulty Levels | Trading | Hirelings | Parties | PvP | Hardcore | Battle.net Avatars | Glossary


Blizzard Representative
An authorized representative of Blizzard Entertainment.
Battle.net System Administrator
An authorized representative of Battle.net.
Moderator
Can remove or ban people from the Channel and designate the next Operator of that Channel when they leave.
Speaker
Can be heard by everyone in a Moderated Channel
Dead Hardcore Character
A dead Hardcore Character that can no longer play in a game.
Unknown Character
Client not recognized by Battle.net. Open Characters clients also appear as this Avatar.
StarCraft: Brood War Client
Client logged in with StarCraft: Brood War.
StarCraft Client
Client logged in with StarCraft.
Warcraft II Battle.net Edition Client
Client logged in with Warcraft II: Battle.net Edition.
Diablo
Client logged in with Diablo.
Referee
Authorized Character for disputes.
